title: When life hits its darkest point, God doesn’t power down—
paragraphs:
When life hits its darkest point, God doesn’t power down—
He steps in with FULL strength.
Your lowest moment might be the very place your miracle begins.
Hold on… Heaven is still working.

“The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.”
— Psalm 34:18 (NIV)
